series.title: Searches for "food bank"
series.description: Relative search interest in "food bank" (0 to 100). Searches rise when more people look for help.

series.title: Gas Prices
series.description: Regular gasoline, average retail price. Fuel costs squeeze household budgets within weeks.

series.title: Diesel Prices
series.description: On-highway diesel, average retail price. Diesel drives food transport costs, ours included.

series.title: Egg Prices
series.description: Wholesale price of a dozen large shell eggs. A staple protein whose price swings fast.
series.source: USDA AMS, California Shell Egg report (2844)

series.title: Chicken Prices
series.description: National composite wholesale whole broiler price, per pound. No California-only report exists.
series.source: USDA AMS, Weekly National Chicken report (3646)

series.title: Beef Prices
series.description: Choice boxed beef cutout, per 100 lbs. Wholesale beef costs reach stores within weeks.
series.source: USDA AMS, Daily Boxed Beef Cutout (2453)

series.title: Unemployment Claims
series.description: New unemployment insurance claims filed each week (EDD via U.S. DOL), not seasonally adjusted.
series.source: CA EDD via U.S. DOL (FRED: CAICLAIMS)

series.title: WARN Layoff Notices
series.description: Workers covered by WARN layoff notices from Bay Area employers. Filed 60 days ahead, so it leads job losses.

series.title: Weekly Economic Index
series.description: NY Fed weekly read on national growth, scaled to annual GDP growth. A falling index means a slowing economy.
series.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York (FRED: WEI)

series.title: Eviction Notices
series.description: Eviction notices filed with the SF Rent Board. The last two weeks are left off while filings post.

series.title: Rents
series.description: Typical asking rent, all home types (Zillow ZORI, smoothed). Rising rents leave less for food.
